description: Lists the project's WBS pattern: the ordered segments that make up each WBS code on the project. `required: true` marks the segments the project requires; the cost code and cost type (line_item_type) segments are always marked.

parameters.name: include[]
parameters.description: Optional response extensions. Pass include[]=tier_depth to include the tier_depth field on each segment in the response.

id.description: Unique identifier for this WBS Pattern. Use as the {id} path parameter when operating on a specific pattern.

description.description: Display name / description of the WBS Pattern. Defaults to 'Procore Standard Pattern' when not specified during creation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the WBS Pattern was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the WBS Pattern was last updated.

is_project_level_ordered.description: Whether the project's WBS Pattern segment order has been customised from the company-level order. True once update_segment_order has been called for this project.

segments.description: Ordered list of WBS Segments that make up this project pattern. Each segment represents one dimension of the work breakdown structure (e.g. Cost Code, Cost Type, Sub Job).

items.description: A work breakdown structure project segment

id.description: Unique identifier for this WBS Segment. Use as the segment_id body parameter when calling add_segment or remove_segment on this project pattern, or as segment_id in update_segment_order.

type.description: Domain type of this WBS Segment. One of: 'cost_code' (cost code dimension), 'line_item_type' (cost type / line item type dimension), 'sub_job' (sub job dimension), 'custom' (user-defined dimension)...

name.description: Localised display name of the WBS Segment (e.g. 'Cost Code', 'Cost Type', 'Phase').

position.description: Ordinal position of this segment within the project WBS Pattern. Lower numbers appear first. Use update_segment_order to change positions.

segment_items_count.description: Total number of segment items (e.g. cost codes, cost types) belonging to this segment at the project level. Null when the count cannot be determined.

tier_depth.description: Present only when include[]=tier_depth is requested  (list endpoints only). Flat segments (sub_job, line_item_type)  return 1; tiered segments return the number of levels. Omitted  (not null) when ...

required.description: Whether a value for this segment must be selected when creating a WBS Code (Budget Code). Always true for cost_code and line_item_type segments.

delimiter.description: Character used to separate this segment's value from the next segment in the full WBS Code string (e.g. '-' produces '01-200').

project_can_modify_origin_project.description: Whether project-specific Segment Items (items created at the project level) can be added to this project for this segment.

project_can_delete_origin_company.description: Whether Segment Items inherited from the company level can be deleted from this project for this segment.

structure.description: Hierarchy structure of this segment's items. 'tiered' means items can have parent–child relationships (e.g. cost codes with sub-codes); 'flat' means all items are at the same level (e.g. cost types).

selectable_tiers.description: Whether non-leaf (parent) Segment Items can be selected in the Budget Code picker for this project. Only relevant for tiered segments.

is_included_in_project_pattern.description: Whether this WBS Segment is currently included in the project's WBS Pattern. Use add_segment / remove_segment to change this.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this WBS Segment was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this WBS Segment was last updated.

wbs_pattern_id.description: ID of the WBS Pattern this segment belongs to. Matches the parent pattern's id field.
